card.name: Self-directed or same-kind reference words
card.fires_on: Words that point back to the same person, animal or group, such as own, itself, yourself, their or his, or the inside of cannibal and self-indict. It fires where the text discusses acts done to oneself or to one's own kind.

modes.label: Reflexive and own
modes.description: Reflexive or possessive words that refer back to the subject.
modes.example: Skin grafts from a person's<< own>> tissues.

modes.label: Own-kind acts
modes.description: Words about harming or eating one's own kind, or kin terms after such a possessive.
modes.example: they will even eat their own brothers and<< sisters>>.

modes.label: Inside self- or cannibal words
modes.description: Partway through words built on self or cannibalism.

card.writes: It favors words about indirect contact, contact and imitation, and suppresses self- words, so it seems to move the output away from a self- continuation.
card.plain: It lights up when the text refers back to oneself or one's own kind, as in own, itself, or cannibalism.
